definitions.model_init_time_utc: Initialisation time of the NWP cycle the inputs came from.
definitions.data_acquired_at_utc: When DRIFT downloaded the inputs; null unless the pipeline recorded it (never invented).
definitions.generated_at_utc: When this artifact file was built (builder clock).
definitions.forecast_available_time_utc: When the forecast became available to users; null unless an observed publication confirmation exists (never inferred from generation or init).
definitions.valid_time_utc: Instant (or window start/end) the forecast refers to.
definitions.nwp_forecast_hour: valid_time - model_init_time. A model property, NOT warning lead time.
definitions.operational_lead_hours: valid_time - forecast_available_time. null with a status unless availability is recorded; never negative; never derived from model init or generation time.

time_semantics.note: forecast_lead_hours / nwp_forecast_hour are the NWP forecast hour. time_until_valid_hours (legacy) is valid minus GENERATION and is not an operational lead. operational_lead_hours is null: no forecast availability time is recorded by the pipeline.

predictor_availability_note: Predictors in unavailable_predictors are null in every cell: null means 'not computed', never zero. Hazard scores were computed WITHOUT them.

hazard_definitions.thunderstorm: Fixed-weight heuristic over GFS instability indices. A risk score, NOT a calibrated probability, even though the legacy field is named thunderstorm_probability.
hazard_definitions.cloudburst: Field named cloudburst_probability. Where the source is panindia_cb_v1 it is an uncalibrated-for-this-use model score for a heavy-rain DAY (IMD gridded rainfall >= 64.5 mm/24 h at 0.25 deg), not a verified hourly cloudburst. Heavy rainfall, extreme short-duration rainfall and verified cloudbursts are distinct events; none is verified here.
hazard_definitions.flash_flood: Heuristic derived from the cloudburst/thunderstorm scores. A risk score, NOT a flood probability and not validated against flood observations.
hazard_definitions.official_warning: None of these values is an IMD/NDMA warning. DRIFT outputs are model advisories only.
